summary: AI Coach Context Upgrade (iter 82) — Backend 13/13 pass, Settings INJURIES UI verified end-to-end. Verified: (1) PUT /api/profile with injuryDetails → injuryFlags derived as ACTIVE-only names (['Hamstring']) with Neck/Cervical past/severe echoed back normalized. (2) Legacy PUT injuryFlags path reconciles into injuryDetails: previously-active injuries dropped from flags become status='past' (kept, never deleted). (3) Capture-on-edit: PUT sleepHours=7.5/stressLevel='low' → onboardingAnswers.sleepHours/stressLevel mirrored (verified via GET /api/profile response). (4) POST /api/plan/apply-injury-update 200 and profile.injuryDetails stays consistent with newInjuryFlags. (5) POST /api/coach/chat 'how many weeks out' returns coherent response referencing weeks/meet/competition (Claude 12–20s). (6) POST /api/coach/chat 'session notes' surfaces seeded shoulder-click / grip-on-log-press notes for test_strongman. (7) Coach chat conversation_id persists across calls after background coach_memory pipeline (no 500s). (8) ADD_EXERCISE regression: 'Add 3x10 face pulls…' returns added_exercise with name='Face Pulls', category, sets=3, reps=10. (9) Intake regression: POST /api/profile/intake (fresh user) success:true and profile.onboardingAnswers populated with goal/experience/lifts/sleepHours/etc. FRONTEND: logged in as test_strongman, navigated /settings; INJURIES section renders two cards (Shoulder general Severe/Active, Knee general Mild/Past); severity chips (Mild/Moderate/Severe) and status chips (Active/Past) render with correct pre-selection; tapping Moderate on Shoulder card visibly toggles selection and reveals 'Save injury changes' button; 'Add injury flag' opens bottom-sheet modal listing all preset injuries (Rotator Cuff, Elbow, Wrist/Forearm, …); picking 'Ankle / Foot' adds a new card defaulted to Moderate/Active (correct new-card defaults). WEAKNESSES & TARGETS and TRAINING PROFILE sections still render (no crash). Deprecated packages detected: expo-av must be migrated to expo-audio/expo-video before SDK 54 (pre-existing, app-wide).

ui_bugs.issue: After tapping 'Save injury changes' for a severity-only edit (Shoulder severe→moderate), no window.alert/dialog was fired at the browser level (page.on('dialog') captured 0 messages). If the success confirmation is intentionally an in-app toast/modal that's fine, but from a black-box test perspective there is no visible confirmation that the write completed. Consider adding a testID on the toast/confirmation modal (e.g. testID='inj-save-success') so success is verifiable in automated tests. Reference: /app/frontend/app/settings.tsx handleSaveInjuries / doAcceptInjuryChanges (~line 286).

No testID/data-testid on any injury card element (card, severity chip, status chip, save button, add-flag link, add-injury modal picker options). This forces text-selector-only automation and is fragile once labels are ever localized. Recommend testID='inj-card-{name}', 'inj-sev-{mild|moderate|severe}-{name}', 'inj-status-{active|past}-{name}', 'inj-save-btn', 'inj-add-flag-link', 'inj-add-flag-modal-{name}'.

Console warns: 'No route named "onboarding" exists in nested children'. Root layout references an 'onboarding' route that doesn't exist in /app/frontend/app/ (only onboarding-intake.tsx and onboarding-path-picker.tsx exist). Reference: /app/frontend/app/_layout.tsx.
Console warns: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Pre-existing app-wide.
Console warns: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' Pre-existing app-wide.

action_items: (Optional / observability) Expose onboardingAnswers explicitly in GET /api/profile response so it can be asserted client-side without a Mongo probe. Currently the field is persisted but not always in the serialized response.

Add testID props to INJURIES section in /app/frontend/app/settings.tsx: injury card, mild/moderate/severe chips, active/past chips, 'Save injury changes' button, 'Add injury flag' link, add-injury modal picker options. Also add a testID on the save-success confirmation (toast or modal).
Migrate expo-av → expo-audio / expo-video before SDK 54.
Remove or replace the stale 'onboarding' route reference in /app/frontend/app/_layout.tsx (route does not exist under app/).
Refactor style props: replace deprecated shadow* with boxShadow; replace prop pointerEvents with style.pointerEvents.
critical_code_review_comments: /app/backend/server.py PUT /api/profile (line 521-538) correctly ensures 'injuryDetails' is source of truth AND injuryFlags is DERIVED in the same $set (line 528-533). Verified end-to-end: sending injuryDetails always produces active-only injuryFlags, sending injuryFlags reconciles into details without losing history.

_ONBOARDING_EDIT_MAP + _onboarding_capture_updates (line 423-441) correctly capture-on-edit into dotted onboardingAnswers.* keys with an onboardingAnswersUpdatedAt timestamp — clean, additive, and idempotent.

/app/frontend/app/settings.tsx: 'Save injury changes' visibility is correctly gated on injuriesModified. However the save handler's success confirmation is not verifiable via automation (no visible testID / no window.alert). Adding a testID on the toast will make future regressions catchable.

server.py POST /api/coach/chat still returns conversation_id and background _update_coach_memory runs asynchronously without blocking the request path (line ~4708 asyncio.create_task) — verified by two sequential chats both returning 200 with valid conversation_ids.
